summary: GeoPark Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing business and financial updates that reference two pending acquisitions: operated working interests in the Vaca Muerta shale (Loma Jarillosa Este and Puesto Silva Oeste blocks, Neuquen Basin, Argentina) and a strategic entry into Venezuela via the Bare Block heavy-oil asset in the Orinoco Belt, expected to close in Q4 2026 subject to conditions. No price, stake, premium, advisor or board recommendation is disclosed in the excerpt. Watch for definitive terms, financing and closing conditions, plus Venezuelan regulatory and political risk.
